facts.fact: The operator lists 27–31 December opening 9:30 am, last entry 4 pm, closing 5 pm;1 January opens 11 am, last entry 4 pm, closing 5 pm. The castle closes 25–26 December. Individual internal museums have their own closures.
facts.location: Castle opening-times table and internal-museum tables.

facts.fact: Advance tickets are advised; once online admissions sell out, no further tickets are available at the castle. Adverse weather can cause closure, and visitors should check ahead.
facts.excerpt: Opening times are subject to change

notes: Actual castle operator table read. Castle admission is a daytime visit, not permission to attend a midnight fireworks launch or occupy the esplanade during event operations.
